chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen Slays a Tiger Half-God in Epic Eight Aspect Worlds Showdown
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen uses the Eight Aspect Worlds to trap and kill a Tiger half-god, shocking the capital. A display of peerless power at Spirit-Treasury Seventh Heaven.
